title: A Little Life
author: Hanya Yanagihara
current_text: In 2025 A Little Life by Hanya Yanagihara, together with To Paradise, was banned from distribution in Belarus, citing potential harm to national interests.

sources.quote: In 2025, A Little Life along with Yanagihara's subsequent novel, To Paradise , were banned from distribution in Belarus citing potential harm to national interests.
sources.title: Wikipedia: A Little Life (cites Reform.news and PEN Belarus Banned Books list)

sources.quote: В Беларуси запретили книги Паланика, Янагихары и жены польского главы МИД Reform.news 24 января 2025
sources.title: Reform.news: В Беларуси запретили книги Паланика, Янагихары и жены польского главы МИД

ban_rows.note: Distribution restricted in Russia following the November 2023 Russian Supreme Court ruling that designated the "international LGBT movement" as extremist. Yanagihara's novel was among the high-profile English-language titles pulled or restricted by Russian retailers.
Banned in Belarus by addition to the Official List of Publications Harmful to National Interests (Ministry of Information). Decision: 2025-01-24. Country of origin: USA. Documented by PEN Belarus.
